page.layout: One column of name entries, with a year beside each group in the right margin; a marginal note in the left margin beside the fourth group. Printed page number at the top right.

main_text.l: Cop Buning. Initiū belli inter Gron. & vicinos in agro.

page.notes: The left-margin note reads "Initiū belli inter Gron. & vicinos in agro." and is placed beside the "Cop Buning" line where it stands in the scan. The years 1329 to 1335 are printed in the right margin beside their groups and are given here as separate lines. The first group is partly cut off at the top of the page. The long s is printed as f in names such as "Rodulfus" and "Ludulfus"; it is transcribed here as s. The page number is read as 42 from a stylised figure and is slightly uncertain.
